name: John Gallop
role: Black Hills freighter (Guild and Gallop; Gallop & Walton)
bio: John Gallop kept a stopping place on the road to the Black Hills, where a party traveling the new freight route was put up in April 1884, and with Guild, as Guild and Gallop, hoped to build a railroad from De Mores to the Hay Creek coal mines. In December 1884 the outfit of Gallop & Walton loaded Hills freight at Medora.

moments.label: Planned a railroad to the Hay Creek coal mines
